verdict.rationale: GlitchTip is self-hosted and 'aims to be Sentry API compatible' (glitchtip-docs-11), implying data stays in the user's own Postgres/Redis stack and could interoperate with other Sentry-compatible tools, but there is no documented explicit 'export all data' feature, bulk export tool, or open-format export (CSV/JSON dump) in the evidence pack, and probes for docs/openapi endpoints returned 404s. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export feature/documentation, evidence of open-format bulk export, and independent confirmation that self-hosting alone satisfies full data portability.
